title: BILL - Sync errors with accounting systems and surprise fees
clean_text: Several customers report chronic sync errors integrating BILL with accounting platforms like QuickBooks Online, Sage Intacct, and NetSuite, with one reviewer describing corrupted historical client data in QuickBooks as a "horrible experience." Customer support is described as "hit or miss." One G2 reviewer reported an unauthorized $50 instant-payment fee being collected, and noted BILL charges for expedited service without guaranteeing delivery time. International payment capabilities are also described as limited compared to dedicated cross-border providers, and customizing automatic notifications has reportedly been glitchy.
